title: G Chord Cheat, Alternate Picking & 6/8 Time (JustinGuitar Module 6)
summary: In this 79-second JustinGuitar beginner lesson (Module 6), Justin introduces a simplified G chord fingering described as a “cheat” to make the shape easier and sound better, then moves into an overview of alternate picking and basic picking mechanics. The lesson also includes foundational music theory by explaining time signatures with a focus on 6/8 time and its rhythmic feel (often associated with a waltz-like feel), followed by a practical note on naming the notes on open strings and a technique for forcing chord changes to keep playing along. He concludes with a preview of the week’s songs, tying together technique, rhythm, and practical playing for beginners.
